# Module ESSAY001 — Climate Adaptation Policy
# Department of Geography | Spring 2026

Formatting and submission requirements

Citation style: APA 7th edition.
Font: Times New Roman, 12 pt.
Line spacing: double (2.0).
Alignment: justified.
Margins: 1 inch on all sides.
Page size: Letter.
Page numbers: top right.
Word count: 2000 words.
Minimum of 10 scholarly references.
Include a cover page, table of contents, and abstract.
Required sections: Introduction, Literature Review, Analysis, Conclusion, References.

Submit as a DOCX file by 15 May 2026.
